tables.title: Effect of low-power modes on GPDMA
tables.text_helper: Table 105, "Effect of low-power modes on GPDMA", in section 19.6 (GPDMA in low-power modes) on page 978. Columns: Mode, Description. 3 data row(s). Notes: 1. Refer to Section19.3.2 to know if any Stop mode is supported.

rows: No effect. GPDMA interrupts cause the device to exit Sleep mode.
The content of the GPDMA registers is kept when entering Stop mode.
The GPDMA is powered down and must be reinitialized after exiting Standby mode.
notes: 1. Refer to Section19.3.2 to know if any Stop mode is supported.
